 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MADHURESH PRASAD  ORAL ORDER 2 19-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State, as well as learned counsel for opposite party No.2.
2.

Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Hussainganj P.S. No. 324 of 2022, instituted for the offence under Sections 341, 323 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Petitioner is husband of opposite party No.2.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is willing to reconcile the issue with his wife.
He further submits that the petitioner will make all genuine efforts to reconcile the issue so that the reconciliation culminates in Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.47261 of 2023(2)
dt.19-08-2023 restoration of matrimonial harmony or one time settlement.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for opposite party No.2 do not object to such proposal as long as amicable settlement is reached between the parties.

6. In view of the such submission, since terms of amicable settlement are to be worked out to facilitate the same, the Court directs that, till further orders, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with above noted case.

7. Let the parties appear before the District Mediation Centre, Siwan on or before 28.08.2023.
8.
Learned Mediator shall submit his report to this Court within three months thereafter.
9. Matter be listed after receipt of the report or on 22.11.2023, whichever is earlier.

(Madhuresh Prasad, J) shashank/-
